name: standing chest stretch (with training wall bars)
description: Holding a wall bar and turning away from it stretches your chest and shoulder. The bars let you pick the exact height that suits you.
instructions: Stand beside wall bars and grip a bar at about shoulder height with one hand.
Slowly turn your body away from the bars until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
